title: Clock Strikes Noon — Logic Bomb Activated

fields.headline: AODB Failure at Noon
fields.narration: The clock hits 12:00 PM. The AODB server (AODB-SVR-01, 10.1.10.20) abruptly stops responding. Across the airport, FIDS displays go dark. Gate management terminals flash 'NO DATA'. A new file appears on the desktop of the AODB server: README_NCIA.txt. The file reads: 'You should have hired me. — D'. The AODB service has been stopped. The database is encrypted. The FIDS data feed is gone.
keyFacts: AODB database files encrypted with AES-256
Ransom note placed on server desktop
Attack was executed via scheduled task AODB_IndexMaintenance
fields.expectedAction: Ops assesses terminal-wide disruption. IT confirms the logic bomb executed. Security verifies no physical threat but confirms a cyberattack has occurred.
fields.facilitatorNote: Pause for effect after reading the first sentence. Then read the rest in a steady, controlled tone. Show the 'README_NCIA.txt' file on screen if available.
fields.scenarioTitle: Scenario 8: Anonymous Threat, Logic Bomb Hunt

instructorNote: This is the final inject. The threat has executed. If the team neutralized it earlier, skip to the success path. Otherwise, this triggers full crisis management and post-incident response.
